claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2, N>=5, M=N-2. In the cluster degeneration (eps b,1,-1) with b distinct, nonzero and Hank_k(b) != 0 for k<M: (1) in w=1/(eps T), after dividing by w^3, the span tends to the one-double-root pair space with double root at 0 and simple roots 1/b_i (hypothesis (b) of the count identity); (2) if that space attains T_conf(N) with minimal branch and infinity multiplicities and has no Weierstrass point at w=0, the separated Wronskian discriminant is a unit times its discriminant D^conf(b)+O(eps), so components of Delta_W^nc=0 meeting such cluster regions are reduced if D^conf is reduced there.
claims.assessment: Working proof: coalescence of the far pair +-eps in w gives the confluent pair fibre (independent by the confluent pair fibre lemma), Hurwitz on discs; group factorization with binary face (Q_r), binomial neck rings (neck window theorem with det Gamma_k = C Hank_k) and bubble. Merging loci Hank_k(b)=0 and components avoiding cluster regions are not covered. Consistency test at N=5 timed out (tool limits); only one direction of reducedness transfers.
claims.rationale: Connects the off-collision half of open statement 3 near cluster regions to the one-double-root discriminant, the object of the collision half.

relationships: Confluent pair fibre and its independence.
